metric_lineage.basis: first crossing and maintenance through the simulated horizon; not distributed returns or lifetime ROI

limits: One existing recurring cleaning market; no new demand from winning or renewing a contract.
Synthetic declared offers and greedy stable-lot order; no equilibrium, optimal bid or measured customer preference.
Awards use currently funded modeled capacity and prior service only; no future outcome is consulted.
Locked contracts can become under-served; a declared breach clause permits the next renewal, without guaranteeing a new supplier.
Rational service is allocated proportionally; no individual clinical/job timing or statistical availability claim.
One provider/month invoice rounds summed locked-price service once; per-lot collections are not inferred.
Base Business price arrays are checked projections of initial offers; actual invoices use the separately recorded locked lot prices.
Buyer switching bills lie outside the operator/provider consolidation; recipient onboarding is already in enterprise costs.
Cash recovery subtracts recorded unpaid bills and financing principal/equity inflows. It is not distributable cash, lifetime ROI or funding of all unissued future commitments.
Contract periods after the observation window, residual assets and company valuation remain unobserved.

entry_transition.legal_contract: Share closing changes ultimate equity ownership only; legal accounts, assets, existing customer contracts and obligations remain. Ordinary subsequent renewal may separately reassign service.
limits: Synthetic share purchase only; no asset purchase, legal/tax opinion, debt novation, vendor rights grant or real valuation
Price is paid to the selling owner, not to the operating company; target working capital requires separate funded equity
Diligence is a prior committed bill; consideration/transition/equity closing is atomic and a failed closing is not automatically retried
Hybrid growth is a separately committed business leg and can proceed if the acquisition fails; no automatic synergy or payroll removal
Disruption is a declared whole-target service suspension with retained paid obligations, not an observed acquisition effect
Existing operating-company assets, leases, unpaid liabilities and receivables stay with their legal counterparties; ultimate owner is a separate register
Fixed wide consolidation includes seller, buyer and robot-commercial parties; cash is not profit and opening-payable settlement is not new current-period resource use
No dividends, target-cash sweep, terminal share valuation, goodwill accounting or lifecycle ROI is estimated

renewing_entry.offer_authority: Operating companies retain separate declared offer mandates after common ownership. This is not independent competition or optimized group pricing.
renewing_entry.service_boundary: One conserved baseline with actual funded awards, locked prices and prior service; share closing alone does not create demand, accepted work or a new customer win.
renewing_entry.information_clock: Atomic share close in phase2 precedes physical work and phase5 renewals. Awards use current funded capacity and prior realized service. Future outcomes are not consulted.
limits: Parent, target and growth-company accounts remain separate. Target cash never funds the parent share purchase.
Inherited mandatory target bills survive. Share closing and later contract renewal are different events.
Common-owner contract transfers are internal reassignment, not new platform customer wins; equity reclassification is separately reported at the actual closing moment.
Fixed separate offer mandates under common ownership are a declared scenario, not real competition, antitrust advice or an optimal parent policy.
No shared site crew, annual resource commitments, typed parts, four-architecture execution, asset recovery or endogenous learning is added to this joint fixture.

Gross awards from outside/unassigned contracts include regained work; newly acquired contract-lot IDs exclude earlier platform ownership and equity reclassification. Neither metric counts unique people.
Window payments, customer assignments and paid diligence do not identify company value, distributable return or whole-service lifecycle economics.

comparison_boundary: One conserved recurring market and one physical/Treasury run. Share closing reclassifies ownership; actual renewal changes firm contracts. Parent and operating cash stay separate. Common ownership uses fixed separate offer mandates, not independent competition or optimized pricing. No terminal value or ROI.
